title: finance.compliance.ims_push.requested
description: A command to finance's own worker: a person holding finance.compliance.ims.push asked for one return period's recorded IMS decisions to be told to GSTN. The pushes themselves are the work, and the consumer reads them from the ledger — nothing about a decision travels in this message. Sending a period nobody asked for never happens: recording a decision queues a push, but only this request sends it.
